negative_reviews.author: Stephen Macdonald
negative_reviews.text: Very disappointing experience today. Chicken karaage inedible. Under cooked, soggy battered chicken, an embarrassment to be passed as Japanese. I make my own at home and this plate of slop should never have made the pass to a paying customer. Hell ramen edible but underwhelming. Noodles not cooked enough and chashu pork bland and insipid. There was Japanese tourists sitting next to me and they left half their noodles uneaten. That says it all really. I won't be back. I'll cook my own, as I know I'm a good cook, unlike whoever was pretending to be chefs in the kitchen today.

Per-site star tabs NOT used (corrupt). Daily Pipe 8b feed NOT used for counts (its reviews[] caps positives at 12/site and drops comment-less reviews). negative_reviews = rating<=3 with a non-empty comment; `negatives` counts ALL rating<=3 including those with no comment. url null (not in source).
